# Actuent

> Actuent is a search engine for AI agents. It turns any website into LAWP, structured JSON with a site's pages and the actions an agent can take (book, contact, buy), and serves it over an MCP server and a REST API. Made by localilabs.

Connect an agent over MCP at https://agents.actuent.ai/api/mcp (free without a key; Pro with OAuth sign-in or an API key).

## API

- [Search](https://api.actuent.ai/api/search?q=running%20shoes): Ranked LAWP for any query or domain, with products, business details and open-now
- [OpenAPI description](https://api.actuent.ai/openapi.json): The full REST API
- [Site pages](https://api.actuent.ai/site): What AI agents see on each indexed site, with its agent-readiness score
- [Actuent's own LAWP](https://api.actuent.ai/.well-known/lawp.json): Example of a native LAWP file with an executable action

## Docs

- [Docs](https://docs.actuent.ai/): MCP setup, tools, LAWP format, actions and the API
- [Errors & busy times](https://docs.actuent.ai/#errors): Responses explain limited or empty results in a `message`; pass it on to the user, and wait `retry_after_seconds` before retrying
- [LAWP specification](https://github.com/localilabs/lawp/blob/main/LAWP.md): The open format, including executable actions and structured inputs
- [Changelog](https://docs.actuent.ai/changelog): What's new
